Extended pytest suite from 15 to 19 tests: added TestUpload (auth-required, PNG upload + /api/files serve returns 200 image/*, non-image .txt returns 400) and TestStorePhotoUrl (create/update/delete persists photo_url + isPartner toggle; 4 seeded stores intact after). All 19 backend tests PASS. Frontend Playwright: /admin login OK → dashboard lists 4 stores → edited REKILDER MODAS in modal (uploaded 1x1 PNG via store-form-photo-upload → store-form-photo-preview appeared with /api/files/... URL, store-form-photo-remove visible; filled whatsapp/address/neighborhood/hours) → Save → reopened form and values persisted → public /loja/{id} shows store-photo, store-whatsapp-button, store-maps-button → /buscar?q=short praia card shows store-card-photo + store-card-whatsapp-button + store-card-maps-button. Cleanup executed: cleared fields + removed photo; verified via GET /api/stores that REKILDER photo_url/whatsapp/address/neighborhood/hours are all empty; re-verified card no longer shows maps/whatsapp/photo (gating works). Seeded 4 stores intact.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py PUT /api/admin/stores/{id} still uses full replace_one — any DB-only fields would be dropped; acceptable while StoreInput mirrors Store, but future-proof with $set on validated dict.

Uploaded object files are never actually deleted from Emergent object storage when a store's photo is replaced/removed or the store is deleted — /admin only sets photo_url='' locally; db.files entries remain and objects orphan. Consider soft-delete + cleanup task.
MIME validation is by file extension only; malicious content with .png extension would pass. Not blocking for MVP but consider magic-byte sniffing.
photoSrc() concatenation assumes photo_url starts with '/'; safe today because backend returns '/api/files/...' but add a leading-slash guard for defensive coding.
Still on deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event startup handlers (carry-over from iteration_1).
seed_data_creation: None persisted.
